TLS Layer for CPS Async Streams

Wraps OpenSSL to provide TLS encryption over TcpStream via AsyncStream vtable. Supports ALPN negotiation for HTTP/2.

Expose the native SSL_CTX_ctrl binding used by the TLS transport.Expose the native SSL_CTX_set_default_verify_paths binding used by the TLS transport.Expose the native SSL_CTX_set_ciphersuites binding used by the TLS transport.

proc tlsShutdownWrite(tls: TlsStream) {....raises: [], tags: [], forbids: [].}
Send TLS close_notify without closing the stream or freeing SSL state. Used for graceful IRC disconnect: sends close_notify so the server knows the TLS session is ending cleanly, but keeps the read side open so readLoop can still see the server's response.
